verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a reasonable privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like sevDesk, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, tracking controls or privacy opt-outs; the items describe only invoicing, bookkeeping, banking, the API and endpoint probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
